description: This file defines the API for a graphing module used to generate text-based visualizations of commit histories in a version control system. It provides function declarations for initializing, updating, and rendering commit graphs, as well as setting display options and managing graph state.

methods.name: graph_setup_line_prefix
methods.description: Configures global line prefix for diff options, allowing display customization.

methods.name: graph_set_column_colors
methods.description: Sets a custom color scheme for graph columns, enabling colorized output.

methods.name: graph_init
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new git_graph structure, optionally with revision options.

methods.name: graph_clear
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a git_graph instance.

methods.name: graph_update
methods.description: Updates the graph to include a new commit, preparing it for line-by-line rendering.

methods.name: graph_is_commit_finished
methods.description: Checks if all necessary lines for the current commit have been outputted.

methods.name: graph_next_line
methods.description: Outputs the next line of the graph representation into the provided strbuf.

methods.name: graph_width
methods.description: Returns the current width of the graph display in characters.

methods.name: graph_show_commit
methods.description: Prints the entire commit's graph representation to stdout.

methods.name: graph_show_oneline
methods.description: Prints a single line of the graph to stdout.

methods.name: graph_show_padding
methods.description: Prints vertical padding lines for the graph.

methods.name: graph_show_remainder
methods.description: Outputs the remaining part of the graph related to the current commit.

methods.name: graph_show_commit_msg
methods.description: Prints the commit message and remaining graph lines to a specified file handle.
